# Test complete SSE/live reload functionality

# Single-file mode: the watched file is served at "/" and its content
# fragment at "/raw".
md2html -http :9020 sse_test.md &
wait-port :9020

# Test that SSE endpoint responds with correct headers
curl -s -I --max-time 1 http://localhost:9020/events
stdout 'Content-Type: text/event-stream'

# The rendered page carries the heading as HTML, not as markdown, and
# arrives wrapped in the full page chrome.
curl -s http://localhost:9020/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'
stdout '<h1 id="sse-test-document">SSE Test Document</h1>'

# /raw renders the same content without the surrounding page.
curl -s http://localhost:9020/raw
stdout '<h1 id="sse-test-document">SSE Test Document</h1>'
! stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

# Stop the script; the background server is terminated with it.
stop

-- sse_test.md --
# SSE Test Document

This tests Server-Sent Events functionality.

## Live Reload

When this file changes, connected clients should receive reload events.
